text:
Nina Roberts: Quick thread  need a one-pager battlecard + a 1-slide benchmark narrative for the Q2 launch. Focus: developer-facing contrasts vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors. Can we ship a draft by Tues?
Diego Marquez: Ill draft the cloud platform soundbites. Short: latency predictability, transparent pricing, rollout controls.
Samira Khan: Ill handle infra vendor rebuts (ops cost, upgrade risk, hidden infra debt). Keep it punchy for SDRs.
Jon Park: I'll mock the benchmark slide. Need p50/p95 for streaming latency + cost per 1k tokens. Use provisional values if needed, label TBD.
Nina Roberts: Good. Top-line claim: "Serve reliably, scale predictably, and control costs across deployment modes." Need 2 quick evidence bullets per competitor type.
Diego Marquez: For cloud APIs: evidence bullet 1: model swap risk (opaque model replacements). bullet 2: unit cost volatility under burst loads. One-liner rebut: "Pin model versions and control routing."
Samira Khan: For infra vendors: evidence 1: hidden ops headcount (1.5 FTE/year per product line). evidence 2: GPU refresh + compatibility cycles add 6-9 months of risk. Rebut: "We handle runtime upgrades and kernel tuning for you."
Jon Park: Draft perf CSV for slide: ```mode,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
hosted,35,110,$0.90
dedicated,28,75,$0.65
self-hosted,50,240,$0.50``` Mark self-hosted latency variance as footnote.
Nina Roberts: SDR Q&A (3 Qs)  Diego, can you drop micro-answers? Example: "How do you avoid surprise model changes?" -> "We enforce model pins + changelogs and test rollouts."
Diego Marquez: Dropping Qs now: 1) SLA options? -> "SLA-backed dedicated tiers available." 2) Data residency? -> "Private control plane + VPC options." 3) Cost predictability? -> "Dedicated capacity + Optimize toolkit for predictable unit economics."
DeckBot: Reminder: webinar asset deadline is 2026-04-02 for legal review.
Nina Roberts: Timeline: draft bullets Mon EOD -> Diego/Samira; perf mock by Jon Tue AM; assemble slide + one-pager Tue afternoon; review Wed morning.
Samira Khan: Pushed infra rebut bullets to doc: https://tiny.redwood/infra-rebut. Includes migration estimate and ops-hours calc.
Jon Park: Uploaded mock slide to drive: https://tiny.redwood/slide-mock. Tagged Nina & Diego.
Nina Roberts: Final note  make all SDR lines scannable (<= 2 lines each). Use :sparkles: one-liner soundbites. Thanks team.
Diego Marquez: Will do. Short and skimmable.
Samira Khan: Done  pinged procurement for real-world figures to replace estimates.
Jon Park: Updated last_message_ts -> 4443210045 after upload.
